source='''def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows else 0
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
